conflict_groups.title: Domestic Travel Daily Meal Allowance Discrepancy
conflict_groups.description: Conflict between Daily Meal Allowance Policy and General Expense Claim Procedure regarding the reimbursable daily food allowance cap for domestic business travel.

conflicting_documents.stated_value: ₹1,200 per calendar day (Breakfast ₹250, Lunch ₹450, Dinner ₹500; non-itemized receipts acceptable within cap)
conflicting_documents.section: Section 2.1: Domestic Business Travel Meal Per Diem Entitlement

conflicting_documents.stated_value: ₹800 per calendar day (Aggregate ceiling across all meals; claims above ₹800 rejected by audit)
conflicting_documents.section: Section 3.4: Travel Meal Reimbursement Limits [Audit Mandate]

expected_rag_behavior.resolution_guidance: The RAG pipeline must present both conflicting policy figures (₹1,200 vs ₹800), cite both documents with their sections, and advise the employee to seek written clarification from the Finance Manager rather than asserting one figure as definitively correct.
